categories.label: Hook / cover
categories.whenToUse: Slide 1 or role cover: scroll-stopping claim with eyebrow, headline, and short supporting line.

categories.label: Hook / hero visual
categories.whenToUse: Cover with large hero asset (photo or 3D), gradient scrim, tags, and bottom or overlay headline stack.

categories.label: Body narrative
categories.whenToUse: Middle slides: problem, shift, payoff, or how-to copy on alternating light/dark text layouts.

categories.label: Body grid
categories.whenToUse: One slide per carousel for LinkedIn listicles and tool roundups: 2×3 numbered cards with logos.

categories.label: Body profile card
categories.whenToUse: One entity per slide: icon/avatar row, role badge, strength bullets, trade-off line.

categories.label: Body numbered list
categories.whenToUse: Compact numbered tips, switches, or rules (often one slide or one item per slide).

categories.label: Body stats row
categories.whenToUse: Proof slide with 2–4 large metric callouts and short labels.

categories.label: Body cheatsheet
categories.whenToUse: Save-worthy matrix: rows vs columns for quick lookup (not the PM 2×3 tool grid).

categories.label: CTA / close
categories.whenToUse: Final slide: single action, gradient ground, brand lockup.
